answer: Allocate matching funds by cluster-discounted quadratic funding: a project's match grows with the square of the sum of the square roots of donations, so many small donors beat one whale. But donors who always fund the same projects are clustered into one grove, and their match is discounted by cluster size. A sybil farm's coordinated donations ripple outward as a single cluster, driving its match toward the nadir. Each puppet must recruit genuinely independent donors or pay full price, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest donors pay once.
